lost_reason: Buying committee could not reach consensus — deal died in internal politics, no decision made

calls.notes: Neha reached out to us — she has a strong use case for our data pipeline tool. Pain: 6 hour ETL jobs crashing weekly. She is very excited. Mentioned that CTO, CFO, and VP Ops all need to sign off. We did not dig into their individual priorities.
red_flags: 3-person committee — no clear single decision maker

calls.notes: Demo call with Neha and CTO Aryan. CTO focused entirely on security and data residency — topics we were not prepared for. He wants data to stay in India region. We had to check internally. Neha tried to redirect to features but CTO was skeptical.
red_flags: CTO has different priority than champion

calls.notes: CFO Rekha joined. She only cares about total cost of ownership over 3 years — asked for detailed pricing model which we did not have ready. CTO still waiting on data residency answer. Neha is frustrated that meetings keep introducing new concerns.
red_flags: CFO has different priority than CTO and champion

calls.notes: VP Ops Suresh joined this time. He wants to know about implementation timeline and who owns post-go-live support. Now we have 4 different stakeholders with 4 different concerns. Neha says internal alignment is difficult. No decision timeline given.

Neha says the committee met internally and could not agree — CTO wants to delay until data residency is confirmed, CFO wants better pricing, VP Ops wants a proof of concept first. She is still our champion but has no power to break the deadlock.
Lost — by inaction. Company decided to delay the project by 6 months and revisit in Q1. No competitor won — we simply lost to no decision. Neha apologized. The committee could never align.

lessons_learned: Multi-stakeholder deal needs individual discovery with each stakeholder in Call 1-2
Map each committee member's priority before the group demo
No decision is still a loss — committee deals need a single executive sponsor to break ties
If committee has 3+ members with different concerns, propose a pre-alignment meeting before group calls
Champion with no power to decide is a risk factor — identify who has the actual veto
Data residency and security questions must be answered by Call 2 or deal slows permanently
